n: 1.9 Cu. Ft. Over-The-Range Microwave with Sensor Cook
hl: Sensors in the microwave determine and set the appropriate power levels and cook time to ensure great tasting meals.
Enjoy peace of mind and fresher air while cooking with the Frigidaire PureAir® Microwave Filter, which captures odors and helps recirculate air from the exhaust fan.
Changing your filter is now more convenient, simply press the door on the top interior panel to swap out your Frigidaire PureAir® Filter.
Quickly move odors and steam away from the cooktop's surface with three levels of ventilation that re-circulate air up to 400 CFM.
Easily wipe away and clean spills from your microwave with the Effortless Clean™ Interior surface.
Get a clearer view of your cooktop with two LED lighting modes that illuminate the cooking surface.
